title: Pad thai with chicken, tofu and bean sprouts
steps: Soak the rice noodles according to the packet and drain.
Stir the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, tomato purée and 3 tbsp water together.
Cut the chicken into strips and the tofu into cubes, fry with the garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, push to one side and scramble the eggs in the pan.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2–3 minutes.
Fold in the sprouts and spring onions and serve with chopped peanuts, chilli and lime wedges.
